fields.name: Red Roses Bouquet
fields.description: A breathtaking bouquet of luxurious long-stem red roses, beautifully wrapped to express deep love, passion, and romance. A timeless classic for unforgettable moments.

fields.name: Pink Roses Bouquet
fields.description: A classic bouquet of fresh pink roses symbolizing appreciation, happiness, and affection. Handcrafted with premium blooms for every memorable occasion.

fields.name: White Roses Basket
fields.description: A beautiful wicker basket overflowing with premium white roses. This elegant floral gift creates a lasting impression for weddings, anniversaries, and heartfelt celebrations.

fields.name: White Roses Bouquet
fields.description: Classic white roses beautifully arranged to symbolize purity, sincerity, and new beginnings. An ideal choice for weddings, anniversaries, sympathy, or elegant celebrations.

fields.name: Lilies Bouquet
fields.description: Elegant oriental lilies in delicate pink and white hues, carefully wrapped to create a fragrant bouquet full of grace and sophistication. Perfect for birthdays, congratulations, and heartfelt gifts.

fields.name: Mixed White Peonies and Gerbera Bouquet
fields.description: Fresh white peonies combined with cheerful gerberas create a soft and sophisticated bouquet that radiates happiness, elegance, and timeless beauty.

fields.name: Mixed Roses Bouquet
fields.description: A romantic combination of premium roses in soft pastel shades. Carefully arranged to create a luxurious bouquet suitable for birthdays, anniversaries, and celebrations.

fields.name: Mixed Chrysanthemums, Lisianthus & Roses
fields.description: A charming hand-tied bouquet featuring delicate roses, elegant lisianthus, and soft chrysanthemums. Designed in romantic pastel shades, this arrangement is perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, or simply brightening someone's day.

fields.name: Orchids Flower Bouquet
fields.description: Luxurious pink orchids arranged into an elegant bouquet that symbolizes beauty, love, and sophistication. A stunning gift for special occasions or corporate celebrations.

fields.name: Chrysanthemums and Peonies Bouquet
fields.description: A luxurious blend of fluffy peonies and elegant chrysanthemums in soft pink and white tones. This bouquet brings warmth, romance, and natural beauty to every special moment.

fields.name: Mixed Seasonal Bouquet
fields.description: A vibrant seasonal bouquet featuring a beautiful mix of premium flowers selected by our florists. Every arrangement is unique while maintaining exceptional freshness and elegance.

fields.name: Mixed Lisianthus & Roses
fields.description: Elegant roses paired with delicate lisianthus and seasonal greenery create a bouquet filled with softness, romance, and timeless charm.

fields.name: Sunflower Bliss
fields.description: Bright and cheerful sunflowers arranged into a stunning bouquet that brings warmth, positivity, and sunshine to every occasion. A perfect gift to brighten someone's day.

fields.name: Sea Breeze Bouquet
fields.description: Inspired by coastal elegance, this bouquet combines soft roses, hydrangeas, carnations, and seasonal blooms in gentle pastel tones for a fresh and sophisticated look.

fields.name: White Teddy Bear Gift
fields.description: A soft, oversized white teddy bear that makes every celebration extra special. The perfect companion for birthdays, anniversaries, baby showers, or romantic surprises.

fields.name: White Teddy Bear & Merci Gift Set
fields.description: Delight someone special with a cuddly teddy bear paired with delicious Merci chocolates. A thoughtful gift set perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day, or simply saying "I care."

fields.name: Pastel Hydrangea Bouquet
fields.description: Delicate and elegant, our Pastel Hydrangea Bouquet features premium blue, pink, and creamy white hydrangeas, carefully hand-tied and wrapped in luxurious pastel paper. Known for their full, cloud-like blooms, hydrangeas symbolize gratitude, grace, and heartfelt emotions. This sophisticated bouquet is perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, baby showers, or simply bringing beauty to someone's day.

fields.name: Happy Birthday Card
fields.description: Celebrate someone's special day with a beautifully designed Happy Birthday Greeting Card, created to add a heartfelt personal touch to your flower or gift order. Featuring elegant floral artwork and a luxurious finish, this premium card is the perfect way to express your warm wishes.
